name: Menander the comic poet
credit: Bust traditionally identified as Menander (Roman copy of a Greek original), Museo Chiaramonti, Vatican; no authentic portrait survives · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: Menander the comic poet is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 4th century BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 72).

poems.title: Book VII, 72: On Epicurus and Themistocles
poems.author: Menander the comic poet
poems.text: Hail, ye twin-born sons of Neocles, of whom the one saved his country from slavery the other from folly.

poems.title: Book XI, 438
poems.author: Menander the comic poet
poems.text: Trust in (?) a Corinthian and don’t make him a friend.
